items.exampleEn: The bar on the corner offers more than fifty kinds of whiskey.
items.exampleZh: 轉角那家酒吧提供五十多種威士忌。

items.exampleEn: This restaurant serves a different stew every day of the week.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳一週裡每天都供應不同的燉菜。

items.exampleEn: The children jumped into a big pile of hay and laughed.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們跳進一大堆乾草裡，笑個不停。

items.exampleEn: The café is famous for its thick pancakes with fresh fruit.
items.exampleZh: 那家咖啡店以搭配新鮮水果的厚鬆餅聞名。

items.exampleEn: In winter, deer may starve if snow covers all the grass.
items.exampleZh: 冬天如果大雪蓋住所有的草，鹿可能會挨餓。

items.exampleEn: Purple plums were piled high at the fruit stand.
items.exampleZh: 水果攤上堆滿了紫色的李子。

items.exampleEn: Walnut trees can grow more than twenty meters tall.
items.exampleZh: 核桃樹可以長到二十多公尺高。

items.sentenceEn: On cold nights, nothing is better than a bowl of hot beef stew.
items.sentenceZh: 寒冷的夜晚，沒什麼比一碗熱騰騰的燉牛肉更好了。

items.audioEn: I'm making pancakes for breakfast. Could you get the eggs and milk from the fridge?
items.audioZh: 我在做早餐的鬆餅。你可以幫我從冰箱拿蛋和牛奶嗎？

items.sentenceEn: If we don't stop for lunch soon, I think I'll starve!
items.sentenceZh: 如果我們再不停下來吃午餐，我覺得我會餓死！

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather keeps a jar of plums in sugar for the winter.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺留了一罐糖漬李子過冬。

items.stemEn: The farmer stored the dry ____ in the barn to feed his cows in winter.
items.stemZh: 那位農夫把乾草存在穀倉裡，冬天拿來餵牛。

items.stemEn: This famous ____ is made in Ireland and aged in wooden barrels for years.
items.stemZh: 這款知名的威士忌產自愛爾蘭，在木桶裡陳放多年。

items.passageEn: Last winter, I spent a week on my friend's farm. Every morning, we fed hay to the horses and then came inside for pancakes with plum jam. My friend's father is a talented cook. In the evenings, he made a rich beef stew that cooked slowly over the fire for hours. After dinner, the adults sometimes shared a small glass of whiskey, while we cracked walnuts by the fireplace. The cats on the farm never starve; they wait by the kitchen door for any food we don't finish. It was a cozy week, and I didn't want to leave.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我在朋友家的農場待了一週。每天早上，我們先拿乾草餵馬，再進屋吃抹了李子果醬的鬆餅。朋友的爸爸很會做菜。傍晚，他會煮一鍋香濃的燉牛肉，在爐火上慢慢燉好幾個小時。晚餐後，大人們有時會一起喝一小杯威士忌，我們則在壁爐邊敲核桃。農場的貓從來不會挨餓，牠們會守在廚房門口等我們吃不完的食物。那是溫馨的一週，我都不想離開了。

options: 抹了厚厚奶油的核桃麵包

questions.questionZh: 農場的貓為什麼不會挨餓？
options: 主人每天都會買貓食給牠們
牠們很會抓穀倉裡的老鼠
牠們等著吃剩下的食物
牠們會跟著馬一起吃乾草

items.promptZh: 她在沙拉上撒了一些碎核桃。
referenceEn: She put some chopped walnuts on the salad.
She added some broken walnuts to her salad.
rubricZh: walnut 可數，「一些核桃」用複數（例如 some walnuts）
時態合理即可（例如 put、has put）；「撒」可寫 put on、add to、sprinkle 等

items.instructionZh: 用 pancake 造一個句子，說說你喜歡怎麼吃鬆餅。
referenceEn: I like my pancakes with butter and a little honey.
On Sunday mornings, I make pancakes for my whole family.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 pancake 或 pancakes
